scope: Ingredient-label estimates for a single cup. All weighed edible ingredients are included. The chocolate is cross-checked against the Finnish-market GTIN and Lindt's EU nutrition declaration.
withholdingReason: The published product labels do not provide the fibre and polyol evidence needed for a complete carbohydrate calculation. No public macro or GK value is supplied.
